## Research Framework

Every investigation follows the same basic progression:

**Demand signal → Verification → Ownership → Public exposure → Financial transmission → Materiality → Investment assessment**

The objective is not simply to identify products that are trending. It is to determine whether unusual consumer behavior can be traced to a **measurable and financially meaningful exposure in a publicly traded company**.

[Read the methodology →](../methodology.qmd)
